title: Evolution of transcription factor-containing superfamilies in Eukaryotes
authors: Dubey A; Muthu G; Seshasayee ASN
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真核生物转录因子超家族的进化与基因数缩放关系，属进化基因组学，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Regulation of gene expression helps determine various phenotypes in most cellular life forms. It is orchestrated at different levels and at the point of transcription initiation by transcription factors (TFs). TFs bind to DNA through domains that are evolutionarily related, by shared membership of the same superfamilies (TF-SFs), to those found in other nucleic acid binding and protein-binding functions (nTFs for non-TFs). Here we ask how TF DNA binding sequence families in eukaryotes have evolved in relation to their nTF relatives. TF numbers scale by power law with the total number of protein-coding genes differently in different clades, with fungi usually showing sub-linear powers whereas chordates show super-linear scaling. The LECA probably encoded a complex regulatory machinery with both TFs and nTFs, but with an excess of nTFs when compared to the relative distribution of TFs and nTFs in extant organisms. Losses drive the evolution of TFs and nTFs, with the possible exception of TFs in Animalia for some tree topologies. TFs are highly dynamic in evolution, showing higher gain and loss rates than nTFs though both are conserved to similar extents. Gains of TFs and nTFs are driven by the appearance of a large number of new sequence clusters in a small number of nodes, which determine the presence of as many as a third of extant TFs and nTFs as well as the relative presence of TFs and nTFs. Whereas nodes showing explosion of TF numbers belong to multicellular clades, those for nTFs lie among the fungi and the protists.
abstract_zh: 基因表达调控有助于决定大多数细胞生命形式中的各种表型。它在不同层面及转录起始点通过转录因子（TFs）进行协调。TFs通过进化上相关的结构域与DNA结合，这些结构域因共享同一超家族（TF-SFs）的成员身份，而与其他核酸结合和蛋白质结合功能（非TFs，即nTFs）中的结构域相关联。在此，我们探讨真核生物中TF DNA结合序列家族如何与其nTF亲属共同进化。TF数量与总蛋白编码基因数量之间呈幂律关系，但在不同支系中比例各异，真菌通常显示亚线性幂，而脊索动物则显示超线性缩放。LECA可能编码了包含TFs和nTFs的复杂调控机制，但与现存生物中TFs和nTFs的相对分布相比，其nTFs过量。丢失驱动TFs和nTFs的进化，可能例外的是动物界中某些树拓扑结构下的TFs。TFs在进化中高度动态，其获得和丢失速率高于nTFs，尽管两者在保守程度上相似。TFs和nTFs的获得由少数节点中出现大量新序列簇驱动，这些簇决定了现存TFs和nTFs中多达三分之一的出现，以及TFs和nTFs的相对存在。显示TF数量爆发的节点属于多细胞支系，而nTF爆发的节点则位于真菌和原生生物中。
